profile.headline: Software Developer | .NET | Maui | C#
profile.summary: I am currently a Software Developer at Ruoff Mortgage, working with a variety of languages to develop and maintain APIs, console applications, mobile applications (MAUI) and MVC apps. I collaborate daily with a small team to write highly functional and innovative code and provide our company the tools it needs for success.

positions.title: Captain
positions.description:
•	Compiling End of Day reports and entering information into local database quickly and accurately. 
•	Assisting with Point-Of-Sale system maintenance such as updating menu items and keeping accurate employee information. 
•	Maintaining the integrity of confidential information.
•	Handling monetary transactions and keeping accurate records.
